ety.text: Borrowed from Classical Persian تیزاب (tēzāb, “aqua fortis”). By surface analysis, तेज़ (tez) + आब (āb).
From दम (dam, “breath”) + ख़ुश्क (xuśk, “dry”)+ होना (honā, “to become”), meaning of breath to be dry.

Borrowed from Classical Persian میان (miyān, “middle; lord, sir (in Indo-Persian)”). First attested as Old Hindi मींयां (mī̃yā̃). Cognate with Bengali মিঞা (mĩa).
